schema.description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24) from BETTNER-TERRANO-1500-ARCHERS-2001 (retrieved 2026-11-27): commands issued during turn 1000 would be scheduled for execution during turn 1002; the communications turn, roughly the round-trip ping time for a message, was divided up into the number of simulation frames the slowest machine could do.

executionTurn.description: The communications turn scheduled for execution: issuedTurn + 2.

issuedTurn.description: The communications turn during which the command was issued.

simulationFramesPerTurn.description: The number of simulation frames the turn was divided into.

turnLengthMs.description: The communications turn length, adjusted to latency.

schema.title: Lockstep command
